name: A Level Further Mathematics (OCR A, H245): Pure Core with Statistics and Mechanics
material_vintage: OCR A Level Further Mathematics A (H245) specification, Version 2 (October 2025), downloaded from ocr.org.uk on 2026-09-27 and itemised in full: all 298 OCR reference codes are items. This course follows the Pure Core (Y540, Y541) with the Statistics (Y542) and Mechanics (Y543) options; the 124 codes of the Discrete Mathematics (Y544) and Additional Pure Mathematics (Y545) options are declared out of scope. Assessment for this route: four 90-minute papers of 75 marks, each 25% (Pure Core 1, Pure Core 2, Statistics, Mechanics). Stage tests and the mock are original questions in OCR's style; every numerical answer was computed with sympy or scipy when the course was built.
level_source: RQF Level 3 (GCE A Level), per Ofqual's register listing for OCR H245

learner_notices.text: This course follows OCR's Statistics (Y542) and Mechanics (Y543) options. The Discrete Mathematics and Additional Pure Mathematics options are not taught, so a learner entered for either of those papers needs another course for them.
Further Mathematics assumes all of A Level Mathematics, which is why it requires alevel_mathematics to be complete first.
